subject: Re: Webinar sponsor trial top-up for BrightSpark attendees
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie@brightspark.events>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: devops@brightspark.events
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Webinar sponsorship — attendee trial top-ups

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re well. Thanks again for sponsoring the "AI at Scale" webinar on June 24 — we had ~1,200 live attendees and the session recording is performing well. A handful of our premium sponsor attendees were late sign-ups and didn’t receive the trial credits you provided during the promo window.

Can Redwood top up 75 trial credits (14-day trials) scoped to the BrightSpark sponsor cohort? We plan to distribute via single-use codes embedded in our follow-up email. The attendees are listed in the attached attendee_list.csv (first name, last name, email, ticket tier).

We have the signed sponsorship summary attached for reference. If there’s any billing or GL code we should reference, let me know — BrightSpark will cover the incremental usage as per the contract.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we plan to send the follow-up on Tuesday, 7/6.

Best,
Sophie Lane
Sponsorship Lead | BrightSpark Events
[sponsor contract attached: sponsor-contract-summary.pdf]

--
BrightSpark Events
events@brightspark.events

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie@brightspark.events>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Webinar sponsorship — attendee trial top-ups

Thanks Sophie — congrats on the turnout, that’s awesome.

Looping in Marissa and Priyom to coordinate fulfillment and GL. Quick questions before we generate codes:
- Confirm each attendee should receive a 14-day trial (no extra credits beyond the trial).
- Is BrightSpark handling any overage charges if attendees convert beyond the trial? We’ll tag the usage to the sponsorship HubSpot record but need billing confirmation.
- Are single-use codes or a bulk redeem link preferred? Single-use is slightly slower to generate but reduces account-sharing risk.

Marissa / Priyom — can one of you (a) confirm approval to allocate 75 sponsor trial activations from promo fund, (b) provide the internal GL/budget code to charge, and (c) confirm whether we should generate single-use codes or a single bulk redemption URL? Sophie hopes to send the follow-up on 7/6.

Karthik
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sophie Lane <sophie@brightspark.events>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Webinar sponsorship — attendee trial top-ups

Thanks — happy to approve the 75 trial top-ups from the marketing sponsorship pool.

Details:
- Approved quantity: 75 single-use 14-day trials
- Internal GL/Budget code: MKT-SP-2026-07 (please reference on the ticket)
- We prefer single-use codes for analytics (we can tie each redemption to the attendee email).
- Delivery: we can produce a CSV of codes (code,email) for you to embed in your follow-up — Priyom, can your team generate the file and place it on the shared Drive?

Sophie — upload the final attendee_list.csv (cleaned to match emails) to the HubSpot record linked below and we’ll match. We’ll also flag Finance for the sponsor chargeback after redemption report.

Attachments: sponsor-contract-summary.pdf (from Sophie)

Marissa Cole
